text:
maria: quick ping — PR #4893: small param rename in public http handler (RequestID -> requestId). tests pass locally but CI formatter failing. can someone take a look?

kevin: can you paste the diff? quick glance: are you changing exported signature?

maria: no, internal handler param only. here's the snippet:
```go
func handleGetUser(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, requestId string) {
  // previously request_id
}
```

maria: ran `gofmt` and `gofumpt -w` locally, still flagged in CI.

alex: isn't exported acronym policy to use RequestID not requestId? but since it's param/unexported it's fine. i'm neutral on exact name, but prefer `reqID` in middleware.

jess: I can take this. small nit: update call sites in metrics middleware too — they use `reqID`.

ci-bot: buildkite PR #4893 — format job failed (gofumpt diff). details: https://ci/build/4893

kevin: If it's just gofumpt, add a tiny commit that runs `gofumpt -w` on the file and push. ping me after.

maria: pushed fixup commit running `gofumpt -w` and updated metrics call sites to use `requestId`->`reqID` mapping. PTAL @kevin @jess

jess: reviewed, looks clean. :thumbsup:

kevin: ok from me. merge when green, squash commits.

maria: thanks! plan to merge at ~15:00 PT if no other objections. will add a one-line changelog entry under "styling".
